package gallery // import "ubunatic.com/loom/gallery"

Package gallery is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package gallery provides live, sample-data demos for Loom widgets.

FUNCTIONS

func Names() []string
    Names returns the available demo names in sorted order.

func New(name string) (loom.Widget, error)
    New constructs one demo by catalog widget name, accepting qualified names
    such as "loom.TextInput" as well as short names.

func NewAll() *loom.Tabs
    NewAll constructs the complete gallery as a tabbed widget.

func NewWithArgs(name string, args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWithArgs constructs one demo by catalog widget name, passing demo
    arguments.

func RequiresAltScreen(names ...string) bool
    RequiresAltScreen reports whether the named demo or demos need terminal keys
    that VTE reserves while applications run on the primary screen. The combined
    gallery includes RichTextEdit, so it also requests the alternate screen.
